en.ideaStatement: A speaker designed around leveled listening.
en.ideaBody:
Leveled listening is sound designed for gathering on the floor. Inspired by floor-sitting cultures, it brings people together at the same height, encouraging a sense of equality and inviting everyone to relax, connect, and listen together.

Each driver has its own enclosure and its own place in the form. This modular approach is intended to limit shared cabinet resonances and unwanted interaction, while giving each part individual attention.

Integrated amplification and adjustable DSP let the system be tuned to the room, the listener, and the way they gather.
en.philosophyIntroduction: We are a collective exploring how things work and how people live. Engineering, culture, and the ways we gather shape the questions we ask—and the objects we make.
en.specMaterialsValue: MDF main and midrange structures · locally sourced Japanese wood horn

ja.ideaStatement: 同じ目線で聴くためのスピーカー。
ja.ideaBody:
Leveled listeningは、床に集まって聴くための音のあり方です。床に座る文化に着想を得て、同じ高さで過ごすことが対等な関係を育み、くつろぎながら語らい、音を分かち合う時間へとつながります。

それぞれのドライバーに専用のキャビネットと、形の中での居場所を与えました。このモジュール構造は、キャビネットを共有することで生じる共振や不要な干渉を抑え、一つひとつの役割に向き合うための設計です。

内蔵アンプと調整可能なDSPにより、部屋や聴く人、集まり方に合わせて音を整えられます。
